chapter_title: Chương 237: 0239 [Cô bé trưởng thành hơn một chút]

segments.title: Chương 237: 0239 [Cô bé trưởng thành hơn một chút]
segments.content:
"I'm almost outside the hotel."

"Okay, we'll be right down."

When Chen Guiliang drove to the hotel entrance, Tao Xue and her parents were already standing there.

Tao Xue's father was dressed in a very classic style, with his shirt tucked into his trousers and a ring of keys hanging from his waist.

"Hello, Uncle. Hello, Auntie."

"We've troubled you, Xiao Chen."

"It's no trouble. Let's get in the car first, we can't park here for long."

Tao Xue quickly got into the front passenger seat and winked at Chen Guiliang. It didn't mean anything specific, just a pure expression of intimacy.

Chen Guiliang winked back twice, then reminded the two elders in the back seat, "Uncle, Auntie, it's going to be a bit hot climbing the Great Wall today. The forecast says the high is 34 degrees. How about we go somewhere else?"

Tao Xue's mother smiled, "34 degrees isn't hot. Back home this month, it hasn't dropped below 37, and it hits 40 all the time."

"That's true," Chen Guiliang also smiled.

What else would elders do when visiting Beijing?

The first day they toured the Forbidden City and its surroundings, so the second day had to be for climbing the Great Wall.

They had probably been dreaming about it for half their lives. Now that they finally had a chance to come to Beijing, they were set on visiting all those places.

By the time Chen Guiliang drove to the Badaling scenic area, it was nearly mid-morning, and the temperature was getting a little hot.

The two elders climbed with great enthusiasm, and Chen Guiliang felt he was doing fine.

But Tao Xue couldn't hold on after just half an hour.

"I can't go on. I'm so tired and hot. You guys go ahead." Tao Xue was so tired she bent over, panting, with her hands on her knees. Her face was flushed, her forehead covered in fine beads of sweat.

Tao Xue's father said, "Then let's rest for a bit."

"I can still climb." Tao Xue's mother shot him a look.

Tao Xue's father didn't get it and was already being pulled away by his wife.

After the couple had walked a dozen steps, Tao Xue's father finally asked, "What are you doing?"

Tao Xue's mother said in a low voice, "The two of us old folks will climb, and the two young ones will climb. We won't disturb each other, you get it?"

Tao Xue's father looked back and finally understood.

Not minding that it would burn his butt, Chen Guiliang sat directly on the steps and handed her a bottle of mineral water. "Have a few sips."

"Thanks, Senior."

Tao Xue instantly perked up, giving the impression that she had been faking it just to get some distance from her parents.

Chen Guiliang looked at the tourists coming and going and couldn't help but complain, "Damn. There are so many people climbing the Great Wall even in this heat."

Tao Xue sat down next to him, sipping her water, and started chattering, "I was cooped up before the college entrance exams, doing nothing but studying. After the exams ended, I couldn't wait to have fun, and I even had my brother take me to play *Sovereignty Over the World*. Haha, he gave me a lot of good gear. There's a horse called Chiji, the first of King Mu of Zhou's Eight Steeds. When it runs, wings actually appear. Someone messaged me in the game, asking if I would sell that horse for 200,000 RMB."

"You could buy a car with that kind of money," Chen Guiliang said with a smile.

Tao Xue said, "My brother told me I can't sell the top-tier gear I have. If I stop playing, I have to destroy it directly. He didn't just give me the horse either, he had me open some chests first."

In *Sovereignty Over the World*, players could preset whether to hide their IDs. If set to hidden, when they obtained a top-tier item, the official announcement would be "Congratulations on obtaining such-and-such item."

When Tao Xue got the first of the Eight Steeds from a chest a few days ago, the broadcast caused a sensation across the entire server. Players from other servers even came to register new accounts just to see what was happening.

Luckily, she had set her ID to hidden beforehand, otherwise, she would have been driven crazy by the in-game private messages.

Even so, Tao Xue's in-game name still got out, because some players saw her riding the horse. It was a fiery red horse, with a wing-like shadow appearing when it ran. It was as cool as could be.

"Maybe because I got the top-tier gear too easily, I didn't feel like playing anymore after just one day."

Tao Xue hadn't seen Chen Guiliang in a long time, and now she had endless things she wanted to tell him. "Then I logged into the Mengya Forum. In my first year of high school, I was obsessed with Mengya and literature, but now it seems I can't find that feeling anymore. Articles I used to think were well-written now feel a bit childish when I read them."

Chen Guiliang commented, "Your thinking has matured. Besides, *Mengya* isn't what it used to be. I heard that last year's New Concept Writing Competition only received a pitiful few tens of thousands of preliminary submissions. The year I participated, there were over 400,000."

Tao Xue suddenly swayed, resting her head on Chen Guiliang's arm. "I really want to go back to my first year of high school. I didn't know anything back then, but everything I did felt new and joyful."

"When you have time, I'll go back to No. 2 High School with you for a couple of days to help you relive your high school memories," Chen Guiliang comforted her.

Tao Xue asked, "Do you still remember the first time we met?"

"I do. Selling books at the street stall." How could Chen Guiliang forget? That was the day he had just been reborn.

Tao Xue sank into her memories. "The first time I saw you, Senior, I thought you were so strange. You were tall and skinny, like a bamboo pole, not nearly as handsome as you are now. You were such a smooth talker back then, you had us all fooled."

Chen Guiliang thought to himself: It was because I thought first-year high school girls were easy to fool that I shouted to attract you guys over.

But he couldn't say that out loud. Chen Guiliang smiled and said, "I wasn't fooling anyone, everything I said was the truth."

"As if! You were a big liar back then!" Tao Xue retorted.

"Haha."

Chen Guiliang let out a couple of happy laughs.

The two of them sat chatting together. In such hot weather, neither wanted to continue climbing up.

After a while, Tao Xue's phone rang.

"Hello, Mom. I'm with my senior at the spot from before… Yes, we haven't moved, we plan to head back the way we came. Once you get to the top, just take the cable car down the mountain, and we'll all meet up at the bottom… Right, remember to drink another bottle of the Huoxiang Zhengqi water from your bag. Rest for a bit if you feel hot, don't get heatstroke."

Tao Xue was indeed more mature than before, even knowing to remind her parents to take care of themselves.

The sun grew stronger, and Chen Guiliang patted his butt and stood up. "Let's head back and find a place to cool off."

Tao Xue said, "In the literature interest group on Xiaonei, someone recommended *Ghost Blows Out the Light*. The night before we came on our trip, I read tens of thousands of words of it. It's so well-written. The author must be an old man who was sent to the countryside during the Cultural Revolution, and he probably really has robbed tombs."

Chen Guiliang laughed out loud. "Maybe a young old man."

"What are you laughing at?" Tao Xue asked.

Chen Guiliang said, "Someday when *Ghost Blows Out the Light* gets published, I'll take you to get the author's autograph."

"You know the author?" Tao Xue asked curiously.

Chen Guiliang shook his head. "Not yet, but I can get to know him in the future."

After *Ghost Blows Out the Light* moved from Tianya to Qidian, its copyright was bought out by Qidian.

But before film and television copyrights became a big deal, Qidian's copyrights were sold very cheaply. Chen Guiliang could find a chance to buy it. In the future, whether it was a movie or a TV series, he could hire whoever he wanted to film it. In any case, he couldn't let them produce a pile of garbage.

Because Chen Guiliang was also a fan of *Ghost Blows Out the Light*.

Oh right, there were also Da Liu's books. He could buy the film and television rights for those too.

Even if Chen Guiliang didn't buy them, Da Liu would sell them for cheap anyway. The TV series of *The Three-Body Problem* people saw later was only made after its copyright had changed hands several times.

Tao Xue chattered on about the plot of the novel *Ghost Blows Out the Light*.

"Have you finished the first story?" Chen Guiliang asked.

Tao Xue said, "No, I've only read a few tens of thousands of words."

Chen Guiliang said, "Let me tell you what happens next."

"No spoilers!" Tao Xue quickly stopped him.

"Hahaha."

Chen Guiliang burst out laughing.
